verdict.rationale: Preventing customer data from being used to train AI models is a fair privacy question for a cloud AI coding agent like Devin, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, data-retention controls, or a no-training policy. Docs on model routing, MCP, VPN and environments are unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
